findings.summary: Thin raycast resolution reuses the generated thin_resolve helper.
Map and WeakMap share get/set emission.
Character wrapper cleanup uses live ID sets instead of nested scans.
Deferred event release moves its vector instead of copying body handles.
WeakMap lookups prune a bounded number of entries; collection reclaims all expired entries.
Catch-free bounded try/finally uses the shared pinned statement lowerer.
Dependent-default overloads derive parameter lists and forwarding values from the source declarations.
Convex hull reduction sorts the existing Bullet index buffer.
Bounce membership indexes retain scheduled entries across steps.
